subject: One-off micro-grants for late registrants — Build With Redwood
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@makerworks.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: events@acme.dev
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick ask — late registrants for Build With Redwood (micro-grants)

Hi Naomi,

We had a last-minute surge of signups for our "Build With Redwood — Code & Coffee" session (Dec 10). A handful of students and community maintainers registered after the cutoff and emailed asking for trial credits so they can follow along with the lab.

Would Redwood be able to approve a small pool of one-off trial grants (10–15 accounts, 3k tokens each) to cover these late registrants? We can provide names and emails; most are individual contributors or non-profits. This would be a community goodwill ask — we’ll call them "micro-grants" in the event page.

If it helps, I attached the attendee export and a one-page request form. We need to confirm by Dec 9 EOD to include the note in the pre-event reminder.

Thanks — Sanjay
Sanjay Patel
Director, Developer Programs
MakerWorks Inc.
attachments: attendee-list-dec2026.csv, microgrant-request-form.pdf

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@makerworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask — late registrants for Build With Redwood (micro-grants)

Hi Sanjay,

Thanks for the note and the attendee list. We’re happy to consider a small micro-grant pool for late registrants — good community impact.

Proposed parameters from our side:
- 12 one-off promo codes, each redeemable for 3,000 free-token trial credit
- Valid for 30 days from issuance
- Restrict to individual accounts (no enterprise domains)

Marissa / Kimberly — can you confirm this aligns with current promo inventory and give a quick ops thumbs-up? If you approve, I’ll generate codes and send them to Sanjay with a short redemption guide.

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Growth Lead, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

Naomi —

12 x 3k is fine from marketing’s pool; low risk and good PR. Two operational asks:
1) Please confirm the email match policy (we should prevent duplicate existing paid accounts from redeeming).
2) We’d like to add a short tracking tag so we can measure conversions back to the MakerWorks campaign.

If ops agrees on the email rules we can mark these as "MWX-MICRO-DEC26" codes.

—Marissa

All — ops reviewed the request. Confirmation and notes below:

Approval: Yes — we can issue 12 unique promo codes, 3,000-token credit each, 30-day TTL.
Operational safeguards implemented:
- Redemption blocked if account has any paid invoice in last 12 months.
- One-time-use codes tied to email; codes will reject if email already on a paid plan.
- Tracking tag: MWX-MICRO-DEC26 added to all codes; HubSpot campaign HL-4783 will receive attribution.
- I’m attaching the generated code list and a brief ops playbook for distribution and support triage.

Hi Sanjay —

Great news: we can provide 12 one-off micro-grant promo codes (3,000 tokens each). Codes are single-use, valid for 30 days, and carry the campaign tag MWX-MICRO-DEC26. Ops blocked redemption by existing paid accounts as requested.

Next steps:
- Attached is the signed microgrant form and the secure code list (please treat as confidential).
- Please share the codes only with the named late registrants and include a short note with redemption steps (copy below).

Redemption steps for recipients:
1) Create (or log in to) a Redwood account with the email you registered with.
2) Visit https://redwood.com/redeem and paste the promo code.
3) Credit activates immediately; expires in 30 days.

If you want me to bake the codes into a short snippet for your reminder email, I can send that within 1 hour.

Warmly,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Growth Lead, Redwood Inference
